missions.title: Ordering noodles
missions.goal: Order a bowl of noodles and a drink, then pay.

steps.partner_en: Hello! How many of you?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's just you, one person.
answers_en: One person.
Just me.

steps.partner_en: Please sit. What would you like to eat?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want a bowl of beef noodles.
answers_en: I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.
A bowl of beef noodles, thanks.

steps.partner_en: OK. Anything to drink?
steps.prompt_en: Ask for a cup of tea.
answers_en: I'd like a cup of tea.
A cup of tea, please.

steps.partner_en: Here are your noodles. Are they good?
steps.prompt_en: Say they're delicious, and ask for the bill.
answers_en: Delicious! The bill, please.
Really tasty. Let's have the bill.

steps.partner_en: That's twenty-eight kuai altogether.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'll pay by phone.
answers_en: I'll pay by phone.
Can I use my phone?

missions.title: Taking a taxi
missions.goal: Tell the driver where to go and pay at the end.

steps.partner_en: Hi, where to?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're going to the train station.
answers_en: I'm going to the train station.
The train station, thanks.

steps.partner_en: OK. Where are you from?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're British.
answers_en: I'm British.
British.

steps.partner_zh: 你的汉语很好！学了多长时间？
steps.partner_en: Your Chinese is good! How long have you studied?
steps.prompt_en: Say thank you, and that you've studied for one year.
answers_en: Thanks! I've studied for a year.
Thanks, a year now.

steps.partner_en: We're here. Thirty-five kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Say here you go, and thank the driver.
answers_en: Here you go. Thanks!
OK, here's the money. Thank you!

missions.title: Buying fruit
missions.goal: Buy some apples and haggle a little.

steps.partner_en: Hello! What would you like?
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much the apples are.
answers_en: How much are the apples?
How much are the apples per jin?

steps.partner_en: Ten kuai a jin.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's too expensive.
answers_en: Too expensive!
Too expensive, make it a bit cheaper.

steps.partner_en: Eight then. How many jin?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want two jin.
answers_en: I'd like two jin.
Two jin, thanks.

steps.partner_zh: 好的，十六块。还要别的吗？
steps.partner_en: OK, sixteen kuai. Anything else?
steps.prompt_en: Say no thanks, that's all.
answers_en: Nothing else, thanks.
That's all.

missions.title: Meeting a classmate
missions.goal: Introduce yourself to a new classmate.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！我叫小明。你叫什么名字？
steps.partner_en: Hi! I'm Xiao Ming. What's your name?
steps.prompt_en: Say hello and tell him your name.
answers_en: Hi! I'm John.
Hi, my name is John.

steps.partner_en: Are you a student?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you study accounting.
answers_en: Yes, I study accounting.
Yes, I'm an accounting student.

steps.partner_en: What do you like doing?
steps.prompt_en: Say you like watching football.
answers_en: I like watching football.
I really like watching football matches.

steps.partner_zh: 我也喜欢！星期六一起看吧？
steps.partner_en: Me too! Shall we watch together on Saturday?
steps.prompt_en: Say great, see you Saturday.
answers_en: Sure! See you Saturday.
Great, see you Saturday!

missions.title: At a café
missions.goal: Order a coffee to take away.

steps.partner_en: Hi, what would you like to drink?
steps.prompt_en: Ask for a hot coffee.
answers_en: I'd like a hot coffee.
A hot coffee, thanks.

steps.partner_en: Large or small?
steps.prompt_en: Say large.
answers_en: Large.
A large one, thanks.

steps.partner_en: Drink here or take away?
steps.prompt_en: Say take away.
answers_en: Take away.
To take away.

steps.partner_en: OK, twenty-five kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Say here you go.
answers_en: Here you go.
OK, here you are.

missions.closing_en: Please wait a moment, it'll be right up.

missions.title: Asking the way
missions.goal: Find out where the metro station is.

steps.partner_en: Hi, can I help?
steps.prompt_en: Ask where the metro station is.
answers_en: Excuse me, where's the metro station?
Hi, where's the metro station?

steps.partner_en: It's ahead. Walk straight on.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if it's far.
answers_en: Is it far?
Is it far from here?

steps.partner_en: Not far, five minutes' walk.
steps.prompt_en: Say thank you very much.
answers_en: Thank you!
Thanks so much!

missions.title: Buying a jacket
missions.goal: Try on a jacket and buy it.

steps.partner_en: Welcome! What are you looking for?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want to look at that black jacket.
answers_zh: 我想看看那件黑色的衣服。
answers_en: I'd like to look at that black jacket.
I want to see that black one.

steps.partner_en: This one? You can try it on.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a bit big, and ask for a smaller one.
answers_zh: 太大了，有小一点儿的吗？
answers_en: It's a bit big. Is there a smaller one?
Too big. Is there a smaller one?

steps.partner_en: Yes, try this one.
steps.prompt_en: Say this one is good, you want it.
answers_en: This one's good, I'll take it.
Looks great! I'll take this one.

steps.partner_en: Three hundred kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if it can be cheaper.
answers_en: Can it be a bit cheaper?
Too expensive, cheaper please.

missions.title: Football chat
missions.goal: Chat with a friend about last night's match.

steps.partner_en: Did you watch the football yesterday?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you watched it.
answers_en: I did!
Yes, it was great.

steps.partner_en: Which team do you like?
steps.prompt_en: Say you like the red team.
answers_en: I like the red team.
The reds!

steps.partner_en: Did they win?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, they won two-one.
answers_en: They won, two-one.
They won, two-one!

steps.partner_zh: 太好了！下次我们一起看吧。
steps.partner_en: Great! Let's watch together next time.
steps.prompt_en: Agree and suggest your place.
answers_en: Sure, come and watch at mine.
OK! At my place.

missions.title: Checking into a hotel
missions.goal: Check in, ask about breakfast and Wi-Fi.

steps.partner_en: Good evening! Do you have a booking?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you booked a room for two nights.
answers_zh: 有，我订了一个房间，住两个晚上。
answers_en: Yes, I booked a room for two nights.
Yes, two nights.

steps.partner_zh: 请给我看一下您的护照。
steps.partner_en: May I see your passport, please?
steps.prompt_en: Hand it over: say here you go.
answers_en: Sure, here you are.
Here it is.

steps.partner_en: All done, your room is on the eighth floor.
steps.prompt_en: Ask what time breakfast is.
answers_en: What time does breakfast start?
Excuse me, what time is breakfast?

steps.partner_zh: 早上七点到十点，在二楼。
steps.partner_en: Seven to ten in the morning, on the second floor.
steps.prompt_en: Ask for the Wi-Fi password.
answers_en: What's the Wi-Fi password?
What's the internet password, please?

steps.partner_en: The password is on the back of your key card.
steps.prompt_en: Thank her and say goodnight.
answers_en: OK, thanks! Goodnight.
Thank you, goodnight!

missions.title: Messaging a Xianyu seller
missions.goal: Ask about a second-hand jacket and agree a price.

steps.partner_en: Hi, I'm here.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if the jacket is still available.
answers_en: Hi, is this jacket still available?
Is this jacket still for sale?

steps.partner_en: Still here, only worn twice.
steps.prompt_en: Ask what size it is.
answers_en: What size is it?
What size is this one?

steps.partner_en: It's a size 2, fairly loose.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if 500 kuai is OK.
answers_en: Would 500 be OK?
Would you sell it for 500?

steps.partner_en: Six hundred minimum, free shipping.
steps.prompt_en: Accept and say you'll pay now.
answers_en: OK, I'll buy it now.
Fine, I'll pay now.

missions.title: At the pharmacy
missions.goal: Explain you have a cold and buy medicine.

steps.partner_en: Hello, what's wrong?
steps.prompt_en: Say you have a cold and a sore throat.
answers_zh: 我好像感冒了，嗓子很疼。
answers_en: I have a cold and a sore throat.
I think I've got a cold; my throat really hurts.

steps.partner_en: Do you have a fever?
steps.prompt_en: Say a little, since yesterday.
answers_en: A little, since yesterday.
A slight fever since yesterday.

steps.partner_zh: 这个药一天吃三次，一次两片。
steps.partner_en: Take this medicine three times a day, two tablets each time.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether to take it before or after meals.
answers_en: Before or after meals?
Do I take it before eating?

steps.partner_en: After meals. Drink lots of water and rest.
steps.prompt_en: Say OK and ask how much.
answers_en: OK, how much?
Got it. How much altogether?

missions.closing_zh: 三十六块。希望你早点儿好！
missions.closing_en: Thirty-six kuai. Hope you feel better soon!

missions.title: Buying a train ticket
missions.goal: Buy a high-speed train ticket to Hangzhou.

steps.partner_en: Hello, where to?
steps.prompt_en: Say one ticket to Hangzhou, please.
answers_en: One ticket to Hangzhou.
I'd like a ticket to Hangzhou.

steps.partner_en: When are you travelling?
steps.prompt_en: Say this afternoon, around three.
answers_en: This afternoon, around three.
One around three this afternoon.

steps.partner_zh: 三点十分有一趟高铁，二等座一百二十块。
steps.partner_en: There's a high-speed train at 3:10; second class is 120 kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Say fine, and ask for a window seat.
answers_en: Fine. Is there a window seat?
OK, I'd like a window seat.

steps.partner_en: Yes. Please show your ID.
steps.prompt_en: Say here's your passport.
answers_en: Here's my passport.
Here you are, my passport.

missions.closing_zh: 好了，七号车厢，祝您旅途愉快。
missions.closing_en: All set, carriage seven. Have a good trip.

missions.title: The delivery rider calls
missions.goal: Explain where you are so your food arrives.

steps.partner_zh: 喂，你好，你的外卖到了。你在哪儿？
steps.partner_en: Hello, your food's here. Where are you?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're in building 3, room 502.
answers_en: I'm in building 3, 502.
Building 3, room 502.

steps.partner_zh: 小区门口的保安不让我进。
steps.partner_en: The guard at the estate gate won't let me in.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'll come down to get it.
answers_en: Then I'll come down for it.
No problem, I'll come down.

steps.partner_en: OK, I'll wait at the gate.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'll be there in five minutes.
answers_en: I'll be there in five minutes.
I'll get there in five minutes.

steps.partner_en: Here you go. Careful, the soup's hot.
steps.prompt_en: Thank him, and say sorry for the trouble.
answers_en: Thanks, sorry for the trouble!
Thanks for your hard work!

missions.closing_en: No worries, remember to leave a good review!

missions.title: Getting a haircut
missions.goal: Explain how you want your hair cut.

steps.partner_en: Hi, how would you like it cut today?
steps.prompt_en: Say shorter, but not too short.
answers_zh: 短一点儿，可是不要太短。
answers_en: A bit shorter, not too short.
Shorter, but not too short.

steps.partner_en: The sides too?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, the sides shorter, the top a bit longer.
answers_zh: 两边短一点儿，上面长一点儿。
对，两边剪短，上面留长一点儿。
answers_en: Sides shorter, top a bit longer.
Yes, sides short, leave the top a bit longer.

steps.partner_en: Would you like a wash?
steps.prompt_en: Say no need, and ask how much.
answers_en: No need. How much?
No wash. How much altogether?

steps.partner_en: Done. How does it look?
steps.prompt_en: Say it looks great, thanks.
answers_en: Looks great, thanks!
Really good, I'm very happy with it.

missions.title: Making weekend plans
missions.goal: Arrange to see a film with a friend.

steps.partner_en: Are you free this weekend?
steps.prompt_en: Say Saturday afternoon you're free.
answers_en: I'm free Saturday afternoon.
I have time on Saturday afternoon.

steps.partner_zh: 我们去看电影吧？有一个新的动画电影。
steps.partner_en: Shall we see a film? There's a new animated one.
steps.prompt_en: Say great, you've wanted to see it for ages.
answers_en: Sure! I've wanted to see it for ages.
Great, I've been wanting to see it.

steps.partner_en: So what time and where shall we meet?
steps.prompt_en: Suggest two o'clock at the cinema entrance.
answers_zh: 两点在电影院门口见吧。
answers_en: Let's meet at two at the cinema entrance.
Two pm, cinema entrance.

steps.partner_en: OK, I'll buy the tickets.
steps.prompt_en: Say then you'll buy the snacks and drinks.
answers_en: Then I'll get food and drinks.
OK, I'll buy the snacks and drinks.

missions.title: Returning shoes
missions.goal: Exchange a pair of shoes that are too small.

steps.partner_en: Hello, how can I help?
steps.prompt_en: Say you bought these shoes yesterday but they're too small.
answers_zh: 我昨天买了这双鞋，可是太小了。
这双鞋是昨天买的，有点儿小。
answers_en: I bought these shoes yesterday, but they're too small.
I bought these yesterday; they're a bit small.

steps.partner_en: Would you like to exchange or return them?
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to exchange for a bigger size.
answers_en: I'd like to swap for one size up.
Let me swap for a bigger pair.

steps.partner_en: Do you have the receipt?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, here it is.
answers_en: Yes, here it is.
Yes, here you are.

steps.partner_zh: 您试试这双，四十三号的。
steps.partner_en: Try these, a size 43.
steps.prompt_en: Say they fit perfectly.
answers_en: These fit perfectly.
They fit well, I'll take these.

missions.closing_en: All right, they're exchanged for you.

missions.title: Bargaining at the market
missions.goal: Haggle for a vintage leather bag at a market stall.

steps.partner_zh: 随便看看，这些都是老货。
steps.partner_en: Have a look, these are all old pieces.
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much the brown leather bag is.
answers_zh: 那个棕色的皮包多少钱？
answers_en: How much is that brown leather bag?
How much is this leather bag?

steps.partner_zh: 这个是八十年代的，八百块。
steps.partner_en: This one's from the eighties. Eight hundred.
steps.prompt_en: Point out it's a bit worn and offer four hundred.
answers_zh: 有点儿旧了，四百怎么样？
这里都磨坏了，四百块吧。
answers_en: It's a bit worn, how about four hundred?
It's worn here; four hundred.

steps.partner_zh: 四百太少了，我进货都不止这个价。
steps.partner_en: Four hundred's too little; I paid more than that for it.
steps.prompt_en: Say you're a student and offer five hundred as your final price.
answers_zh: 我是学生，五百，不能再多了。
五百吧，这是我最后的价格。
answers_en: I'm a student; five hundred, I can't go higher.
Five hundred, that's my final price.

steps.partner_en: Sigh, six hundred and it's yours.
steps.prompt_en: Pretend to walk away politely.
answers_en: Never mind, I'll look at other things.
Too expensive, I'll try elsewhere.

steps.partner_zh: 好好好，五百五，真的不能再少了！
steps.partner_en: Fine, fine, five-fifty, I really can't go lower!
steps.prompt_en: Accept the deal.
answers_en: Deal!
Alright, five-fifty it is.

missions.closing_zh: 你真会讲价！下次再来啊。
missions.closing_en: You really know how to haggle! Come again.

missions.title: Seeing a doctor
missions.goal: Describe your symptoms and understand the advice.

steps.partner_en: Hello, what seems to be the problem?
steps.prompt_en: Say your stomach has hurt since last night.
answers_zh: 我从昨天晚上开始肚子疼。
昨天晚上起肚子一直疼。
answers_en: My stomach has hurt since last night.
My stomach has been hurting since last night.

steps.partner_en: What did you eat yesterday?
steps.prompt_en: Say you had spicy hotpot and a cold drink.
answers_zh: 吃了很辣的火锅，还喝了冰饮料。
answers_en: Very spicy hotpot, and a cold drink.
I had hotpot and something iced.

steps.partner_en: Any diarrhoea?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, three times this morning.
answers_en: Yes, three times this morning.
Yes, three times in the morning.

steps.partner_zh: 应该是肠胃炎。这几天吃清淡一点儿。
steps.partner_en: It's probably gastroenteritis. Eat plain food for a few days.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether you need to take medicine.
answers_en: Do I need medicine?
Should I take any medicine?

steps.partner_zh: 我给你开一点儿药，一天三次。
steps.partner_en: I'll prescribe something; three times a day.
steps.prompt_en: Ask when you can eat spicy food again.
answers_en: When can I eat spicy food?
How long until I can have spicy food?

missions.closing_zh: 至少一个星期以后。好好休息！
missions.closing_en: At least a week. Get some rest!

missions.title: Calling the landlord
missions.goal: Report a broken water heater and arrange a repair.

steps.partner_en: Hello, what's up?
steps.prompt_en: Say the water heater is broken and there's no hot water.
answers_zh: 家里的热水器坏了，不能洗澡。
answers_en: The water heater's broken, no hot water.
The water heater's broken; I can't shower.

steps.partner_en: When did it break?
steps.prompt_en: Say it stopped working the day before yesterday.
answers_en: It stopped working the day before yesterday.
It's been broken since the day before yesterday.

steps.partner_zh: 我找师傅明天下午去看看，你在家吗？
steps.partner_en: I'll get a repairman to come tomorrow afternoon. Will you be in?
steps.prompt_en: Say you have class in the afternoon; ask if the morning works.
answers_zh: 我下午有课，上午可以吗？
answers_en: I have class in the afternoon; is the morning OK?
I'm out in the afternoon; does the morning work?

steps.partner_en: Fine, ten tomorrow morning then.
steps.prompt_en: Ask who pays for the repair.
answers_en: Who pays for the repair?
Will you be paying for the repair?

missions.closing_en: Don't worry, I'll pay for that.

missions.title: Dinner with friends
missions.goal: Order several dishes for a group, then ask for a doggy bag.

steps.partner_en: What would you all like?
steps.prompt_en: Ask what the restaurant's speciality is.
answers_zh: 你们这儿的招牌菜是什么？
answers_en: What's your signature dish?
Anything you'd recommend?

steps.partner_zh: 我们的红烧肉和酸菜鱼都很有名。
steps.partner_en: Our braised pork and pickled-cabbage fish are both famous.
steps.prompt_en: Order both, plus a vegetable dish.
answers_zh: 那两个都要，再来一个青菜。
红烧肉、酸菜鱼，再加一个炒青菜。
answers_en: We'll have both, plus a greens dish.
Braised pork, pickled fish, and stir-fried greens.

steps.partner_en: Would you like the fish spicy?
steps.prompt_en: Say medium spicy, because one friend can't eat very spicy food.
answers_zh: 中辣吧，我朋友不太能吃辣。
answers_en: Medium, my friend can't handle much spice.
Mild is fine, someone's scared of spice.

steps.partner_zh: 吃得怎么样？还需要什么吗？
steps.partner_en: How was everything? Need anything else?
steps.prompt_en: Say it was great; ask for the bill and a box for leftovers.
answers_zh: 很好吃！买单，再帮我们打包。
太好吃了。麻烦打包，然后买单。
answers_en: Delicious! The bill, and could you box this up?
So good. Please box this up, then the bill.

missions.title: Joining a gym
missions.goal: Ask about membership and avoid being upsold.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！想了解一下我们的会员卡吗？
steps.partner_en: Hi! Want to hear about our memberships?
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much a monthly card costs.
answers_en: How much is a monthly card?
What's the charge for a month?

steps.partner_zh: 月卡三百，但是年卡更划算，只要两千。
steps.partner_en: Monthly is 300, but the annual card is better value, just 2,000.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to try one month first.
answers_zh: 先办月卡吧，看看习惯不习惯。
answers_en: I'd like to try one month first.
Monthly first; let's see if I get used to it.

steps.partner_zh: 我们还有私教课，第一节免费。
steps.partner_en: We also have personal training; the first session is free.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if you have to buy more sessions after the free one.
answers_zh: 免费课以后一定要买吗？
上完免费的，必须继续买吗？
answers_en: Do I have to buy more after the free one?
After the free session, must I keep buying?

steps.partner_en: Not necessarily, it's up to you.
steps.prompt_en: Say fine, you'll sign up for the monthly card today.
answers_en: OK, I'll get the monthly card today.
Fine, a monthly card for today.

missions.closing_en: Great, please fill in this form.

missions.title: Lost property
missions.goal: Report a bag you left on the metro.

steps.partner_en: Hello, do you need help?
steps.prompt_en: Say you left your bag on the train.
answers_en: I left my bag on the metro.
I left my bag on the train.

steps.partner_en: Which line? Roughly what time?
steps.prompt_en: Say line 2, about twenty minutes ago.
answers_zh: 二号线，大概二十分钟以前。
二号线，二十分钟前下的车。
answers_en: Line 2, about twenty minutes ago.
Line 2, I got off twenty minutes ago.

steps.partner_en: What does the bag look like?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a black backpack with a laptop in it.
answers_zh: 是一个黑色的双肩包，里面有电脑。
黑色的背包，里面有一台笔记本电脑。
answers_en: A black backpack with a computer inside.
A black rucksack with a laptop in it.

steps.partner_zh: 请留一下您的电话，找到了马上通知您。
steps.partner_en: Please leave your number; we'll tell you as soon as it's found.
steps.prompt_en: Give your number and ask how long it usually takes.
answers_zh: 我的电话在这儿。大概要多久？
answers_en: OK. How long does it usually take?
Here's my number. About how long?

missions.closing_zh: 一般一两个小时就有消息。
missions.closing_en: Usually there's news within an hour or two.

missions.title: Debating a match
missions.goal: Argue about a penalty decision with another fan.

steps.partner_zh: 刚才那个点球绝对不应该给！
steps.partner_en: That penalty just now should never have been given!
steps.prompt_en: Disagree: say you think it was a foul.
answers_zh: 我不同意，那明明是犯规。
answers_en: I think it was a foul.
I disagree, it was clearly a foul.

steps.partner_zh: 他自己摔倒的，根本没碰到！
steps.partner_en: He fell over on his own, there was no contact!
steps.prompt_en: Say the replay shows he touched his leg.
answers_zh: 回放里很清楚，他踢到了对方的腿。
answers_en: Watch the replay, he touched the leg.
The replay's clear: he kicked the other player's leg.

steps.partner_zh: 好吧……可是裁判今天真的很偏心。
steps.partner_en: Fine... but the ref's been really biased today.
steps.prompt_en: Half-agree, and say the first half was worse.
answers_zh: 这个我同意，上半场更差。
有一点儿，上半场判得更不公平。
answers_en: That I agree with; the first half was worse.
A bit; the first half was even less fair.

steps.partner_en: Who do you think will win in the end?
steps.prompt_en: Predict a two-one win for your team.
answers_en: I think we'll win two-one.
We'll win, two-one.

missions.closing_zh: 那我们打个赌，输了请喝啤酒！
missions.closing_en: Let's bet on it then: loser buys the beer!

missions.title: Asking a colleague for help
missions.goal: Politely ask a colleague to explain a spreadsheet.

steps.partner_zh: 怎么了？看你好像很着急。
steps.partner_en: What's up? You look stressed.
steps.prompt_en: Say you don't understand this spreadsheet and ask if they have time.
answers_zh: 这个表格我看不懂，你现在有空吗？
不好意思，这个表我不太明白，能帮我看看吗？
answers_en: I can't make sense of this spreadsheet; are you free now?
Sorry, I don't really get this sheet; could you take a look?

steps.partner_en: Sure, which part?
steps.prompt_en: Ask why the total in this column is different from last month.
answers_zh: 这一列的总数为什么和上个月不一样？
为什么这里的合计跟上个月不同？
answers_en: Why is this column's total different from last month?
Why doesn't this total match last month?

steps.partner_zh: 因为这个月多了两笔退款。
steps.partner_en: Because there were two extra refunds this month.
steps.prompt_en: Say you understand now, and ask where the refunds are recorded.
answers_zh: 原来是这样，退款在哪一页？
answers_en: Got it. Where are refunds recorded?
I see. Which sheet are the refunds on?

steps.partner_zh: 在第二页，我给你标出来。
steps.partner_en: On the second sheet; I'll highlight it for you.
steps.prompt_en: Thank them and offer to buy them a coffee.
answers_zh: 太感谢了，我请你喝咖啡！
谢谢你，下午我请你喝咖啡吧。
answers_en: Thanks so much, coffee's on me!
Thanks, let me buy you a coffee this afternoon.
